speaker: Head Coach
quote_text:
An ugly game. Are you happy with the result?  No, no, I'm absolutely happy. I just said  
to the players that I'm more happy today than  Brentford game. The reason why is because I was  
quite worried about this game. It's a tricky game,  tricky stadium, tricky team. They are defensively  
top. They are one of the five best teams in Europe  in terms of clean sheet. So you struggle to create  
chances against them and it was not an easy game  and you have to deal and you have to learn to  
play different games. You know, long ball, second  ball, channel, set pieces. It's football. It's not  
only just yeah, how good do we play on the ball,  it's also how you defend, how you deal with that.  
And I'm very proud today and as I said, more happy  today than Brentford game for sure. We're gonna  
prepare the game always. We prepare the game to  try to win every game. But sometimes there is  
also another team there that they try to do the  same. So we are happy today. Malik, Enzo, what do  
you think you could have done differently in the  second-half to create more chances? I think it  
was just that one long range effort from Enzo that  was the only shot on target in the second. Yeah,  
I said we knew already that was a tough game in  terms of clear chances if you see them last game  
against Arsenal, but in general they always, you  always struggle to create chances against them.  
For sure we could attack better, but there was not  a space for coal. We tried the last half an hour,  
we tried to move a little bit and so as attacking  midfielder Mal next to Moi to change something.  
But overall, in this kind of games, knowing  that you are not going to create many chances,  
you have to be clinical. I think first half we  had the Nico 1v1 with keeper, the post from Nico,  
we had another 2-3 chance inside the box. If  you are able to be clinical there and score,  
probably the game become completely different. But  until that moment you want to struggle. And just  
a word on Tosin's performance and how important  is he going to be over the next few weeks given  
the injuries that you've got? Yeah, no, Tosin  was very good. Levi was very good. I think  
all the players defensively today, they were,  we were very good. So happy for them. Again,  
clean sheet. We don't concede. We arrive to the  Christmas moment, you know, second in the table,  
best attacker, one of the best defenders. So we  are happy. But the most important thing is that  
we need to learn to play different kinds of games.  And today was not an easy game. Bobby. Hi Enzo,  
Robert Sanchez has been criticised a lot  recently but I thought he was outstanding  
today. Just a word on his performance. Not  yet. I think Robert did one save first half  
and then second-half he did one more. So  overall for sure we are happy about Robert,  
but overall I think he's also there to help us  when we need him. And how did the wind? It was  
very windy out there. How did that affect the  game? Because Everton likes to play a lot of  
long balls. I imagine it made it a lot harder for  your defenders. Yeah, as I said, today game was  
completely different game compared to the rest.  You have to learn and you have to deal with,  
as I said, long ball, second ball, channel,  you know, set pieces, throwing. It's not easy,  
but the way they showed, you know, togetherness  has been brilliant today. Thank you. Thank you.
title: Enzo Maresca post-match press conference | Everton 0-0 Chelsea
